gaps.sentence: Only by practising daily ___ you improve your fluency.
gaps.explanation: Only by doing X will you… — future inversion after only by.

gaps.sentence: Never ___ I imagine the project would take two years.
gaps.explanation: Never would I have imagined… — conditional flavour with inversion.

gaps.sentence: So ___ was the crowd that the concert was postponed.
gaps.explanation: So great was the crowd that… = the crowd was so great that…

gaps.sentence: Also worth ___ is the museum's medieval wing.
gaps.explanation: Also worth noting is… — fronted comment structure.

gaps.sentence: Never have I ___ such a stubborn refusal.
gaps.explanation: Inversion: Never have I + past participle — never adds emphasis.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the tickets expensive, but they were also sold out.
gaps.explanation: Not only were the tickets… — inversion with 'be' needs no auxiliary.

gaps.sentence: Only after the third attempt ___ she pass the test.
gaps.explanation: 'Only after' at the front forces question word order: did she pass.

gaps.sentence: To such an extent ___ prices risen that buyers withdrew.
gaps.hint: To such an extent + past perfect
gaps.explanation: To such an extent had prices risen that… — emphatic result.
